body:
Tranquility of Sinichuichi
I recently had the chance to try some Sinichuichi 10x Extract.  I tried it with my friend, 'K' who took the same dosage as I did.
Method:
I wasn't exactly sure the best way to ingest this so we made a tea out of the powder by boiling it in water for a few minutes.  After it cooled down, we proceeded to drink the liquid and powder together, ensuring that we got everything.
Honestly, drinking things that are bitter isn't hard for me, I just get through it, sometimes even enjoying the bitterness.  I've had way worse than this, it was bitter, but totally drinkable.
Effects:
T - 15min:  Starting to feel 'different' similar to the feeling before I would consider myself high (on cannabis) things aren't really crazy or anything, but I'm definitely coming off baseline.
T - 30min:  By this time I was starting to experience euphoria and tranquility. I could notice this throughout my body as it was starting to feel a bit heavier and more relaxed.  I decided at this point that I loved Sinichuichi and couldn't believe that I hadn't experienced this before.  If I were to lay down, it felt so good, as if that is what I was suppose to do, simply relax. I laid outside in the sun and found it almost orgasmic to the point where I made little noises that confirmed that I was really relaxing, and the sun just felt so great...
T - 1HR: Before this point I was really enjoying myself, just walking around (or not), feeling relaxed and blissful. Eventually though the experience veered from the euphoric and tranquil aspects and delved into a more sluggish, tired, and lethargic type
the experience veered from the euphoric and tranquil aspects and delved into a more sluggish, tired, and lethargic type
. K and I could hardly walk, and we found ourselves pretty dizzy when we tried to. Speaking, thinking or really doing much of anything was hard. On top of that, it imparted to us the worst cotton-mouth ever!  There wasn't enough water in the world to fix it, and attempting to eat food was a disaster!  I don't think we had ANY saliva so everything tasted horrible and the texture was SO DRY.
I felt like I had been drugged.  K and I were dead tired, and couldn't really do much of anything, we made the observation that we were quite useless and didn't like this anymore.  We tried to take a nap to shake the lethargy from us, but that proved only minimally useful.
T - 1HR 30min:  I would say at this point is when I started to feel it wear off and I could act like a real person again, it still left me a little bit tired though but not so bad. K seemed to be affected by a stomach ache and huge pupils from this point and a while after as well.
So to sum it up, the first 1/2 hr - 1hr was happy, tranquil and euphoric, but it slips downhill from there, at least in this experience.
Overall:
I would say that the inital feelings I felt at the beginning were nice and I would be happy to feel them again, yet I didn't like the transition it took at about 45-1hr in.  I may try it again to see if the effects I get are different.
Definitely an interesting plant.
